description: This file implements the TrialComparisonCertVerifier class, which manages certificate verification jobs with a primary and trial verifier, including job state management, verification process coordination, and result comparison for testing different verification paths.

classes.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job
classes.description: Represents a verification job that manages primary and trial certificate verification processes, compares results, and reports outcomes.

classes.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Request
classes.description: Represents a verification request issued to a Job, owned by the caller, used to handle completion and abortion callbacks.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Start
methods.description: Initiates the verification process, first with the primary verifier, and sets up callbacks for completion.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnConfigChanged
methods.description: Marks the job as having a configuration change, affecting subsequent verification steps.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::DetachRequest
methods.description: Detaches the associated request, indicating it is no longer interested in verification results.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Finish
methods.description: Completes the job, logs results, and triggers the report callback.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::FinishSuccess
methods.description: Marks the job as successfully completed with matching results.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::FinishWithError
methods.description: Marks the job as completed with a discrepancy or error.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnPrimaryJobCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of the primary verification, initiates trial verification if applicable.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnTrialJobCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of the trial verification, compares results, and determines success or failure.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnPrimaryReverifyWithSecondaryChainCompleted
methods.description: Handles re-verification with the platform verifier when chains differ, to check for equivalence.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Verify
methods.description: Main entry point for certificate verification requests, manages job creation and execution.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::SetConfig
methods.description: Updates the verifier configuration and propagates changes to jobs.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to monitor verifier events.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::UpdateVerifyProcData
methods.description: Updates internal verify process parameters and notifies jobs of configuration changes.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::RemoveJob
methods.description: Removes a job from the active jobs set.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::ProcessImplParams
methods.description: Processes implementation parameters to generate primary and trial verifier configs.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::NotifyJobsOfConfigChange
methods.description: Notifies all active jobs of configuration changes.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when underlying verifiers change, triggers job notifications.
